## Security Review

Reviewers should use the root `SECURITY_CHECKLIST.md` to decide which items
apply to this change.

- [ ] Input validation changed or new user-controlled input added
- [ ] Authentication, authorization, session, or signature behavior modified
- [ ] New external fetch, webhook, redirect, or URL parsing behavior added
- [ ] Dependency, GitHub Action, Docker image, or third-party script added
- [ ] Secret handling, token storage, logging, or environment variables changed
- [ ] Security items above were reviewed, marked not applicable, or signed off
